gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-lao-loope: Funky, friendly Groovy holds one marker-like line from end to end. What stands out most is how its constant-width strokes meet Noto Sans Lao Looped, whose words form solid blocks with bowls left unfinished on one side.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Squeezed and playful, Groovy nearly seals each c into a narrow slit with loosely tracked lowercase. But Noto Sans Lepcha keeps every curve generously open, its lowercase standing with the stature of cast iron capitals.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Noto Sans Limbu reads wide-mouthed and sturdy, its curves gaping and its small letters built with generous bodies. Groovy's wirelike strokes then add a friendly, funky wobble up top.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-lydian: The text reads low and level, with capitals barely taller than the lowercase. Noto Sans Lydian opens each curve as wide as a sprung paper clip, against Groovy's nearly closed letters.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Noto Sans Mahajani lets its lowercase rise against the capitals, with a funnel-wide throat in the e. And once the text runs on, that wide-throated e keeps it moving, a soft foil to Groovy's blunt marker-tip strokes.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Groovy holds its line width steady through every turn and squeezes each c into a narrow slit. Noto Sans Mandaic loosens the page with curvy, unclamped letters beneath it.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Stencil-cut and cheerful, Groovy squeezes each c nearly shut at a single constant width. But Noto Sans Marchen leaves its curves ending in clear daylight, its small letters standing proud, almost capital-sized.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-mayan-num: Groovy brings a friendly, funky slit of a c and loosely tracked lowercase. And Noto Sans Mayan Numerals reads easily over a long run, its big-bodied small letters keeping a visibly gaping c.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-medefaidr: Noto Sans Medefaidrin lifts its lowercase high and keeps its curves free of ink pooling where a stroke turns in. Next to it, Groovy's closed, friendly letters feel playful and tight-lipped.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-meetei-ma: Groovy squeezes each c to a narrow slit, drawing every stroke at a single line weight with loosely tracked lowercase. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek gapes like a cracked bangle beneath it.
